prompt.project_info: Create a realistic handheld smartphone flash portrait of an approved adult man seated on a black motorcycle beside an urban road at night.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man with medium-length messy wavy hair, wearing a brown sleeveless tank, open black motorcycle jacket with supplied patches, and black baggy pants. He holds a black graphic helmet and looks directly at camera with a calm confident expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium portrait with motorcycle, motion-blurred road, tall buildings, streetlights, and city ambience. Preserve brand marks only when attached as optional logo/text references.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct phone flash on face and upper body, deep background shadows, realistic low-light grain, raw ungraded urban-night mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic handheld smartphone image, vertical framing, sharp subject, natural perspective, accurate hands, helmet, motorcycle, and flash falloff.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a realistic vertical handheld smartphone flash portrait of an approved adult man seated on a black motorcycle beside an urban road at night. He has medium-length messy wavy hair, wears a brown sleeveless tank, an open black motorcycle jacket with supplied racing patches, and black baggy pants, and holds a black graphic helmet while looking calmly at camera. Include motion-blurred road, tall buildings, streetlights, and city ambience. Use direct phone flash, deep background shadows, low-light grain, natural perspective, and raw ungraded realism. Preserve logos only with supplied logo references.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, cinematic color grade, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted motorcycle, altered logo text
